_note: Reference/documentation copy of the character portion of new_campaign_state.json (the file engine.py actually loads for a fresh game). Keep these in sync if you tune starting values.
name: Lev Davidovich Trotsky (Leon Trotsky)
role: Bolshevik Central Committee member; Chairman, Petrograd Soviet

attribute_notes.oration: Already a renowned public speaker and polemicist well before 1917 - strong from the start.
attribute_notes.intellect: His clearest strength - a serious Marxist theorist and prolific writer.
attribute_notes.resolve: Solid but not yet tested by the scale of crisis 1917-1918 will bring.
attribute_notes.presence: Commands rooms more than he wins hearts one-on-one - see the low cultivating_allies skill tier.
attribute_notes.cunning: His weakest attribute by design - Trotsky operated mostly in the open, not through factional intrigue, which is exactly what makes the Arrogance liability and low Cunning skills bite in play.

untrained_of_note: military_strategic_planning (he has zero military background at campaign start - a deliberate growth arc if the player leans into founding the Red Army later, mirroring Command in the earlier, simpler system this one replaced)

note_on_growth: The Level 7 example sheet this system was drafted from (Oration 18, Intellect 22, Resolve 16, Presence 14, Cunning 12, Physique 12, five perks, Expertise in four Oration/Intellect skills) is a plausible late-campaign state reachable from these Level 1 numbers via a handful of Option C (attribute) and Option A (skill) level-up choices over roughly six level-ups - it is NOT the fresh-game starting point. See new_campaign_state.json for what an actual new game loads.
